caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a sculpted figure of a parrot perched on top of a rounded black base. The parrot's body is shaded in brown with green wings that have detailed feather patterns, and there are red accents along the lower edge of its wings and tail. The beak and eyes are dark grey or black, and the parrot faces toward the right side of the composition. The base on which the parrot stands is black with a geometric, pedestal-like shape, featuring a spherical top section and a square bottom. The background is plain and uncolored, consisting of an off-white or beige surface without any additional objects or elements.
title: Parrot
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
